item.lead:
You have a sorted list of characters, and each character's position in it will be its id. To look an id up by character, the list needs flipping into a dictionary.

Below, a five-character list stands in for the 65. Run it, then work out by hand what the two lookups return before you read the output.
item.follow: You saw the pairs flipped: the list position became the value and the character became the key, so stoi['a'] is 3 and stoi['!'] is 2 here. That gives character to number. With encoding ready, the text can be cut into training and validation parts, starting with the ninety percent split.
